evidence.quote: Individuals that do not have the necessary available funds to pay for services, with annual household incomes between 201% and 400% FPG will be eligible for up to a 75% discount of gross charges, as illustrated by the table below.

asset_test.details: Patients with verified available cash on hand (liquid assets) to pay hospital balances are not eligible; cash on hand is verified using application documentation and considered in addition to income and family size.

evidence.quote: Patients who have verified available cash on hand (liquid assets) to pay hospital owed balances will not be eligible for financial assistance, per this FAP.
Financial assistance will be considered at any point in the billing cycle, up to 240 days from the 1st billed date, post discharge date or date of service.

how_to_apply: Submit a complete application with documentation in person or by mail to BTNRH, 555 North 30th Street, Omaha, NE 68131; phone requests at 531-355-8195; applications also available at East and West Admissions and online.
warnings: Purpose section says income between 100% and 400% FPG qualifies, while the eligibility section gives free care at or below 200% FPG; used the specific eligibility section and table.
Application window clock start is ambiguous: '1st billed date, post discharge date or date of service'; counted_from set to other.
Underinsured (insured with out-of-pocket costs) patients are eligible; the 'up to 75%' discount wording is shown as fixed tiers per the table (75/50/25%).
Policy also requires patients to cooperate in exploring alternative assistance, including Medicaid.
